name: 案件と依存関係を並べる日程表
prompt:
Use case: text-localization / ui-mockup. LH09-0056 two-project annual timeline component only.
Edit ORIGINAL crop image2; full image1 context. Originals PRIMARY for every icon shape, proportions, stroke/optical weights, exact day values, bar/dependency geometry, artwork and visible states. Image3 mock SECONDARY Japanese wording; its repeated dates, duplicate project rows, missing amber/warning glyphs, mint avatars/bar and black dependency are wrong.
Pure-white canvas. Two-level original yearly axis across top, August through next October. Japanese month labels「8月 9月 10月 11月 12月 2026年1月 2月 3月 4月 5月 6月 7月 8月 9月 10月」; preserve ORIGINAL rolling day numerals/positions unchanged, not repeated4/18. Current badge「4月8日」white on forest-green gradient and thin aligned green vertical line. Right white「今日」「年⌄」controls. No invented hidden ticks.
LEFT exactly TWO project info rows, correct different content/states:
1 Original headphone icon「利用者体験の調査支援」, empty dashed status circle, original amber outlined progress symbol, three gray ascending priority bars, original black avatar/white artwork.
2 Original document icon「利用者の声と行動の集計」, source green circular rising-wave health glyph, original amber progress symbol, ORIGINAL ORANGE SQUARE WITH EXCLAMATION priority, same original black avatar artwork. Preserve black artwork without inventing initials or new text. Top row selected with fine neutral outline on white, second plain white.
RIGHT preserve original compact schedule geometry near April. Upper label「利用者体験の調査支援」above small EMPTY white rounded bar with green outline. Lower label「利用者の声と行動の集計」above small WHITE neutral-outlined bar with fine repeated left-facing chevrons(first red, rest gray), final gray outline diamond. Below「目的の共有と整理 +4」. Original RED VERY FINE DOTTED S dependency joins upper-right to lower-left through red circular-minus marker. Original curve/locations/strokes, no heavy dots or solid green endpoint.
Faint neutral vertical gridlines, original horizontal balance with spacious timeline at right. Labels Meiryo Regular14/24, metadata12/16 tracking0; no display headings/bold body. Slate utilities #526173; retain meaningful green health, amber progress, orange urgent, red dependency conflict, source avatar artwork. No broad tints, mint blocks, extra rows/controls/metrics or outer card. All original information and controls intact.
reviewNotes: Distinct project rows, source rolling dates, health/progress/urgent indicators and fine red dependency restored versus mock. Black avatars redrawn, amber glyph anatomy/lower bar and chevron placement drift; retain pending source-artwork and icon fidelity.
